Elevate your style with the Anti-Tarnish Elara Ring, a stunning open-band design that blends elegance with modern charm. One side sparkles with premium zircon stones, while the other shines with a sleek gold-plated finish—perfect for women who love a classy yet contemporary touch. Adjustable and durable, this ring is ideal for daily wear, parties, or gifting someone special

notes: Contradiction for owner review: the description calls the ring "Adjustable and durable" while the export offers three fixed size options (6, 7, 8) with a diameter mapping. Both are carried (Size attribute + variants); the owner must decide which fit claim is true before publish.

The karat claim ("18k") is dropped from the Material candidate value — karat-on-plated is not a claim this catalogue makes (ADR-018/ADR-035, P297 precedent). The quote preserves the source's exact wording.
